problem: During a completed-batch status lookup, the operator sees `unknown` after one record failed, so the operator cannot decide whether to retry that batch.
outcome: The operator can distinguish a completed batch in which every record succeeded from a completed batch in which any record failed.
acceptance: For the requested completed batch, the operator observes success when every record succeeded
For the requested completed batch, the operator observes failure when any record failed
The observation identifies the requested batch
non_goals: Starting retries or changing batch history
